sections.section_name: Section D - Application and Problem Solving

questions.question_text: Rohan goes to a stationary shop. He buys a pencil for ₹5, an eraser for ₹3, and a sharpener for ₹2. He gives a ₹20 note to the shopkeeper. How much did his items cost in total, and how much money will the shopkeeper give back to Rohan?
questions.answer: Step 1: Total cost = ₹5 (pencil) + ₹3 (eraser) + ₹2 (sharpener) = ₹10. Step 2: Money returned = ₹20 (given) - ₹10 (cost) = ₹10. The shopkeeper will give back ₹10.

questions.question_text: Nina has a toy box. She takes out her toys and sorts them: 4 teddy bears, 6 toy cars, and 2 building blocks. How many toys does Nina have in total? Which type of toy does she have the most of?
questions.answer: Step 1: Total toys = 4 (teddy bears) + 6 (toy cars) + 2 (blocks) = 12 toys. Step 2: Compare the numbers (6 is greater than 4 and 2). Nina has the most toy cars.
